items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Just like Lawrence Welk is today.

ctx.x: Was it the same performers, or were there different performers?

Well, yeah, you know, we had...at The Follies, we had new performers every week. All the old colored performers that would come in town nearly we'd use them a week or so, you know, at The Follies in our act. But our band went on every week. We did a different number--maybe some novelty or somethin'--and then we had the entertainers, and we played for the entertainers right in the middle. Just like Lawrence Welk is today.

One of the things you were telling me on the telephone was that the format of this film that you made for Warner Bros. was almost identical to what Lawrence Welk's Show is on television now--the band and then specialty acts.
